messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: Crossover counts
parts:
It is explained in the help file, "For each individual we count the minimal number of crossovers that explain the observed genotype data." For RI lines, it is counting the exchanges AA->BB or BB->AA along each chromosome.

karl
